note: Pilot cast for 'Rio's Lemonade Stall' (Class 3-5). Three different voice ideas per character; listen in studio/voice-casting.html and pick one each.

characters.name: Narrator
characters.line: It was the hottest day of the whole summer. The sun was shining, the roads were sizzling, and everyone in the colony was thirsty. That is when Rio had a big idea.
options: A warm, friendly Indian woman in her thirties telling a story to young children in English with a gentle Indian accent, clear and expressive, full of wonder, unhurried pace.
A cheerful, kind Indian man in his thirties, a favourite storyteller for young children, speaking English with a light Indian accent, warm, playful and clear, relaxed pace.
A bright, gentle young Indian woman in her twenties narrating a children's cartoon in English with a soft Indian accent, smiling voice, lively and magical, medium pace.

characters.name: Rio (hero, energetic boy)
characters.line: Yes! Rio's Cool Lemonade, only ten rupees a cup! Come on, come on, who wants a cold drink? This is going to be the best shop in the whole world!
options: A ten-year-old Indian boy speaking English with a light Indian accent, super energetic, excited and fast, cheeky and fun, a young child's voice.
A nine-year-old Indian boy speaking English with a light Indian accent, cheerful, bouncy and confident, clear young child's voice, medium pace.
An eleven-year-old Indian boy speaking English with a light Indian accent, enthusiastic, slightly husky young voice, full of big ideas, quick and animated.

characters.name: Tara (clever observer girl)
characters.line: Wait, Rio. Let me check my notebook. Lemons were thirty rupees, sugar was twenty, and the cups were twenty. So we spent seventy rupees in total. Hmm, that is a lot.
options: A ten-year-old Indian girl speaking English with a light Indian accent, calm, clever and thoughtful, clear and precise, a young child's voice, medium pace.
A nine-year-old Indian girl speaking English with a light Indian accent, smart and confident, a little serious but kind, crisp young voice.
An eleven-year-old Indian girl speaking English with a light Indian accent, gentle, curious and careful, soft clear young voice, unhurried.

characters.name: Mira (creative, bubbly girl)
characters.line: Ooh, ooh, I know! Let's make a giant sign with a smiling lemon on it! Bright yellow, with sparkles! Everybody will see it from the park and come running!
options: A nine-year-old Indian girl speaking English with a light Indian accent, bubbly, giggly and dreamy, very expressive, high young child's voice.
An eight-year-old Indian girl speaking English with a light Indian accent, sweet, excited and imaginative, bright little voice, fast when excited.
A ten-year-old Indian girl speaking English with a light Indian accent, sunny, artistic and playful, sing-song young voice.

characters.name: Customer uncle (friendly grown-up)
characters.line: Arre, lemonade on such a hot day? Wonderful! Give me one cup, young man. Ten rupees? Here you go. Mmm, very nice, very cool!
options: A friendly middle-aged Indian man speaking English with an Indian accent, cheerful and warm, jolly uncle voice, relaxed pace.
An older Indian grandfather speaking English with an Indian accent, kind, slow and smiling, slightly gravelly voice.
A lively Indian man in his forties speaking English with an Indian accent, loud, funny and good-natured, energetic.
